name: Sling
overview: The sling was a precise and effective weapon used in ancient warfare, as seen in Judges 20:16 where skilled men could accurately sling stones without missing. Most notably, the sling was the instrument God used through David to defeat the Philistine giant Goliath, demonstrating that faith and skill combined can overcome seemingly insurmountable odds (1 Samuel 17:40-44). This account highlights the sling not only as a tool of war but as a symbol of divine empowerment through dextrous use in the hands of a young shepherd anointed by God.
